scripts.generate: cd desktop && wails3 generate bindings -f '-tags gtk3' -ts
scripts.test: bun run test:hooks && bun run test:go && bun run test:rust && bun run test:i18n && bun run test:frontend
scripts.test:frontend: cd desktop/frontend && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.test:integration: cargo build --manifest-path meron-core/Cargo.toml && cd desktop && go test -tags integration,gtk3 -v -timeout 10m .
